reuse.why: Extracts the hidden/hidden-group category query the three average actions already shared and reuses it for setZero, and extends the existing getBudgetData for copyPreviousMonth instead of writing new queries.

duplication.why: Removes three copies of the same SQL, but the protected-category rule is still expressed twice: in SQL in getMonthActionCategories and as a JS condition (hidden/group_hidden/goal_def) in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: The selection helper sits in budget/actions.ts next to getBudgetData where the actions live; the template rule (goal_def IS NULL) is encoded inline rather than via the goal-template module, which is acceptable.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, their data query and focused tests are touched.

maintainability.why: A single named selector is easy to own, though its comment describes the opposite of what it returns and copyPreviousMonth keeps its own copy of the rule, so a future change to the rule needs two edits.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction is bypassed; copyPreviousMonth keeps using getBudgetData and the others now use the new getMonthActionCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The skip rule is written as SQL predicates (c.hidden = 0 AND g.hidden = 0 AND c.goal_def IS NULL) in getMonthActionCategories and reshaped as a JS condition (hidden === 1 || group_hidden === 1 || goal_def != null) in copyPreviousMonth.

one_place.where: setZero and set3/6/12MonthAvg take the rule from getMonthActionCategories, but copyPreviousMonth applies it separately in its own condition over getBudgetData rows (budget/actions.ts).
